description: This file contains functions for translating PUCCH (Physical Uplink Control Channel) MAC layer data structures into FAPI (FAPI is a standardized interface for LTE/5G NR) PDU (Protocol Data Unit) format, including specific functions for different PUCCH formats (0-4), and a main conversion function that assembles the PDU with relevant parameters.

methods.name: convert_sr_bits_to_unsigned
methods.description: Converts sr_nof_bits enum to an unsigned integer.

methods.name: fill_format0_parameters
methods.description: Fills FAPI PDU builder with Format 0 parameters based on MAC PDU.

methods.name: fill_format1_parameters
methods.description: Fills FAPI PDU builder with Format 1 parameters based on MAC PDU.

methods.name: fill_format2_parameters
methods.description: Fills FAPI PDU builder with Format 2 parameters based on MAC PDU and UCI bits.

methods.name: fill_format3_parameters
methods.description: Fills FAPI PDU builder with Format 3 parameters based on MAC PDU and UCI bits.

methods.name: get_pucch_format4_m0
methods.description: Determines cyclic shift index (m0) for PUCCH Format 4 based on occurrence index.

methods.name: fill_format4_parameters
methods.description: Fills FAPI PDU builder with Format 4 parameters based on MAC PDU and UCI bits.

methods.name: fill_format_parameters
methods.description: Selects and fills the appropriate format-specific parameters into the PDU builder.

methods.name: convert_pucch_mac_to_fapi
methods.description: Main function that converts MAC PUCCH info into FAPI PDU format, setting common parameters and calling format-specific fill functions.
